status: development plan; no new confirmation scores inspected
objective: Meaningful continual VQA accuracy/forgetting improvement and separate evidence for expert expansion, not a guaranteed positive conclusion or novelty claim.
initialization: Same pure BLIP pretraining as vision study; not VQA-finetuned
hypotheses: Protecting vision experts alone leaves destructive updates in the shared VQA readout. Frozen-base readout LoRA experts can isolate task-specific adaptation with small parameter growth.
Questions distinguish VQA skill shifts invisible to image-only routing. Frozen question/image features may improve task-agnostic expert selection.
Current-train answer competence can guide expert growth more directly than image reconstruction novelty. Must compare to unconditional task growth and report missed learning when reusing an expert.

prior_art.name: Dynamic Routing Between Experts
prior_art.overlap: Frozen VLM backbone, incremental LoRA experts and task-agnostic routing already exist; do not claim these alone are novel.

prior_art.name: SAMoRA
prior_art.overlap: Semantic-aware LoRA expert routing already studied in multitask LLMs; distinct from proving continual VQA adaptive growth.

data.shortages: Report actual source-supported counts without replacement; never fill by duplicated examples.
data.fresh_eval_exclusion: All image identities/SHA256 bytes and namespaced IDs in historical train/validation/eval manifests; selected independently of predictions before development.
data.fit_validation: Original training sources, globally image-byte-disjoint across both protocols and all splits; exclude all old eval and new eval images.
data.pilot: Previously used train/validation splits only; pilot scores are development evidence, not confirmation.

architecture.frozen: Original vision encoder and original question encoder/answer decoder
architecture.expert: Rank8 alpha16 LoRA in all 96 readout self/cross-attention query/value projections; 1179648 parameters per expert
architecture.routing: Top1 global expert using ridge regression on frozen image/text means, no task IDs or answers at inference
architecture.router_memory: 128 deterministic TRAIN feature vectors/task; report bytes; this is feature memory, not memory-free CL
architecture.generation: Greedy, maximum32 tokens; same source scorers as prior experiments

pilot.oracle: Separate diagnostic only, never primary result

development.collapse_guard: Largest final answer fraction must be below0.9 for a successful development selection; report full taskwise answer distributions rather than treating this cutoff as a semantic-quality guarantee.
development.plasticity_guard: Mean pre-to-post gain over tasks AFTER the first must be positive; first-task fitting cannot mask complete lack of later learning.
development.growth_probe: 128 current TRAIN examples; normalized BLIP smoothed token cross-entropy minus each expert's post-training reference; no evaluation labels
development.adaptive_selection: At the locked primary common-budget setting, evaluate BOTH growth margins on full validation. Among candidates with AF no worse than unconditional expansion, positive post-first-task plasticity and largest final answer fraction below0.9, maximize AP; ties prefer fewer experts then smaller margin. If none qualify, preserve and report failure, retaining highest AP only as a failed exploratory candidate. Fewer experts at maintained accuracy, not an adaptive label alone, is required to claim growth efficiency.
development.frozen_first_control: Train only the first expert at the locked common-budget setting; retain it unchanged through later tasks. This controls preservation without further adaptation.
development.selection: Retain strongest independently tuned validation baseline. Primary compute-matched expansion comparison uses strongest shared_lora setting. Report independent tuning separately. Maximize AP subject to AF no worse and positive mean new-task plasticity; if no candidate satisfies, record failure instead of changing criterion.
development.capacity_control: At the locked shared-LoRA setting, also evaluate a shared adapter of rank8 times protocol task count, alpha2 times rank; this matches unconditional expansion total adapter parameters, not its active parameters or FLOPs.
development.additional_development: If pilots identify a failure, record a new dated plan before new validation trials; never use fresh official eval to tune.

confirmation.seed_count_reason: Declared before any fresh official evaluation: eight paired seeds permit minimum two-sided exact sign-flip p=2/256, whereas five seeds cannot attain p<0.05 (minimum2/32). This is not an extension after inspecting confirmation significance.
confirmation.seed_independence: Before any fresh evaluation, exclude development seed17 from confirmation. All eight confirmation training seeds are absent from this method's hyperparameter search; do not retrain the already completed seed17 configuration just to count it twice.
confirmation.fit_rows: Same fit as development; do not merge validation
confirmation.primary_AP_family: For EACH protocol, primary common-budget expansion minus (a) strongest independently tuned validation baseline among shared/replay/full-readout, (b) matched-setting shared LoRA, and (c) total-parameter-matched shared LoRA at the same setting. Identical candidate/baseline conditions are tested once, not counted as independent evidence. Holm correction covers every distinct primary comparison jointly. Other comparisons and endpoints are exploratory.
confirmation.success: Positive paired AP gain and non-increased AF versus strongest declared baseline, meaningful new-task learning, no degenerate answer collapse. Report eight-seed paired deltas and uncertainty, individual task outcomes, parameter/memory growth and actual training exposures. Tiny nominal improvement is not statistical significance. Exact paired sign-flip p-values are two-sided; primary AP tests across two protocols use Holm correction.
confirmation.not_equalized: Base architecture/input/scorers fixed. Full readout parameter count differs. Router feature memory and replay raw-example memory differ and must be explicit. Adaptive skipped phases reduce exposure; do not call equal epochs equal total compute.
